verdict.rationale: Marqeta's velocity controls are a platform resource that limits how much users can spend and how many transactions they can make in a given span of time. When several controls apply to the same user, all of them are enforced, so ops can set amount caps and count rules without writing custom code. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-card scoping (the docs only describe per-user limits), named daily/monthly/all-time window options, and independent or hands-on confirmation of enforcement.
